# match { #labdata.core.match }

```python
labdata.core.match(entries, spec)
```

Find the entries a spec refers to, ignoring its version.

The path matches on the full repository-relative path, on the bare file
name, or on a trailing portion of the path, so a file can be named as
briefly as is unambiguous.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**entries**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[List](`typing.List`)\[[Entry](`labdata.model.Entry`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Catalog to search.

<code>[**spec**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Spec](`labdata.model.Spec`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Reference to match.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[List](`typing.List`)\[[Entry](`labdata.model.Entry`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Matching entries, possibly none or several.
